title: Battery hangs under the hub on a strap
summary: The 1S pack lies along x under the base plate, held by one 10 mm strap through two hub slots; the strap passes over the hub under the AIO, which sits on 4.5 mm posts to make room.

rejected.value: top tray on the AIO screws
rejected.why: the 57 mm pack clashes with the duct walls at tray height (interference gate); clearing the duct tops needs 9.4 mm tray legs and M1.4x16 screws, and raises the CG over the props

rejected.value: deck screwed onto the duct webs
rejected.why: a second print and four more screws for a kid to fumble, and the CG still sits above the prop plane
